Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc

Klasse NpcSnapshot

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.NpcSnapshot
public final class NpcSnapshot extends Object
An immutable copy of everything that defines an NPC.

The unit of persistence and the boundary between the engine and storage. A live Npc is a mutable handle that only the main thread may touch; a snapshot is a frozen value that can be handed to a background thread, written to a database, compared against what is on disk, or sent across a network, none of which would be safe with the handle itself.

It is also what makes storage implementations simple: a repository never sees an Npc, only this, so it cannot accidentally mutate the engine's state or read a half-applied change.

Seit:
1.0.0

      public Optional<NpcSkin> resolvedSkin()
      Returns the last successfully resolved skin.

      Persisted alongside skinSource() so that a restart renders the NPC immediately instead of showing Steve until a lookup completes — and so that an NPC keeps working while Mojang's session servers are down.

      Gibt zurück:
      the resolved skin, or empty if it has never been resolved
